[[Image:AsenathWaite.png|right|160px]]
'''Asenath Waite''' is an [[ally]].  She first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. She can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Hall School]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Sneak]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

Gain $10 when Asenath Waite joins you.

==Mythos Source==
Asenath appears in ''The Thing on the Doorstep'' (1933), written by H.P. Lovecraft. She is actually possessed by the spirit of her father Ephraim Waite.
